comment: alice challenges bob to battleship firing first, so she is p1; both place their fleets by hand at once, each seeing only its own. alice sinks bob's destroyer after he sinks hers, then bob resigns.
Both seats are to act: each view offers its own next ship and the cells it may start on, across and down.
A ship that runs off the board is an illegal_action, and the game does not move on.

body.message: the carrier across from g1 runs off the board

comment: So is a shot before both fleets are placed.

body.message: fire once both fleets are placed

comment: A placement reaches the other seat as an update with no events: its board and fleet are unchanged.
bob's battleship from a1 would overlap his carrier.

body.message: the battleship down from a1 overlaps your carrier

comment: alice's last ship completes her fleet: a ready event, and she waits for bob.
bob's last ship completes his: the battle starts with alice to fire, and her view lists the cells she may fire at.
A shot reports only what it found: here a miss.
Sinking a ship names it: bob sinks alice's destroyer.
A cell already fired at is an illegal_action.

body.message: you have already fired at j10

comment: Cells are caseless; alice sinks bob's destroyer.
bob resigns: the finishing push shows each seat the other's fleet, offers nothing, and carries the summary and the digest.
A later read of the finished game carries the final view.
